title: Delay queue override saved status until actions are re-enabled
summary: Make the Queue file-overrides drawer publish its saved status only after post-save refresh work completes and command buttons are re-enabled.
reason: The broad WebView validation suite showed the series-preview action could be clicked immediately after the saved status appeared while command controls were still disabled.
behavior_before: The drawer could show 'Override saved' before refresh/finalization finished, allowing follow-up clicks to race disabled command controls.
behavior_after: The drawer re-enables command controls before publishing the final saved status, so browser smokes and operators see a complete post-save state.
rollback_plan: Revert the queue file-overrides drawer status sequencing change, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: WebView sequencing only. No backend media policy, queue launch scope, FFmpeg, subtitle, audio, publish/drain, source/scratch/output movement, or settings persistence behavior is intentionally changed. Blocked: this packet currently records only change-control metadata and no implementation/test file touches or manual validation evidence, so the WebView sequencing change must be reconstructed and validated, explicitly parked, or reverted before completion.
